item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00038","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C09","C11","C10"],"selected_candidate_label":"C09","confidence":0.7,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C09 is the only displayed earlier directive with a materially parallel land-disposition structure: recitals identify particular federal lands and explain why the public interest supports changing their status, followed by an operative disposition and a detailed survey description.
